record.paper_title: Selection Principles and Special Sets of Reals
record.original_question: Can the known lower bound u for the additivity number add(Split(T, T)) be strengthened?

evidence.quote: Can the lower bound u on add(Split(T, T)) be improved?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Setting. For an infinite set $X$, let $[X]^\omega$ denote the collection of infinite subsets of $X$. Given an open cover $\mathcal{U}$ of a topological space, a $\tau$-cover is a large cover $\mathcal{U}$ (each point lies in infinitely many members) such that for every two points $x,y$ the sets $\{U\in\mathcal{U}:x\in U,\,y\notin U\}$ and $\{U\in\mathcal{U}:y\in U,\,x\notin U\}$ are not both infinite. Let $T$ denote the family of countable $\tau$-covers (of a fixed Lindelöf, e.g.\ separable metric, space).

For families $\mathcal{U},\mathcal{V}$ of covers, the splittability property $\mathrm{Split}(\mathcal{U},\mathcal{V})$ asserts: every cover $U\in\mathcal{U}$ can be split into two disjoint subcovers $U_1,U_2$ each belonging to $\mathcal{V}$. For a topological property $\mathbf{P}$ defined on subspaces of the real line, define the additivity number
$$\mathrm{add}(\mathbf{P})=\min\bigl\{|\mathcal{F}|:\mathcal{F}\subseteq\mathbf{P},\ \bigcup\mathcal{F}\notin\mathbf{P}\bigr\}.$$

Let $\mathfrak{u}$ denote the ultrafilter number, i.e.\ the minimal cardinality of a base for a nonprincipal ultrafilter on $\omega$. It is known that
$$\mathfrak{u}\le \mathrm{add}(\mathrm{Split}(T,T)).$$

Question. Can this lower bound be improved? That is, can one prove in ZFC a strict inequality $\mathfrak{u}<\mathrm{add}(\mathrm{Split}(T,T))$, or establish a larger known cardinal characteristic of the continuum as a lower bound?
artifact.status_search_result: The question appears in surveys of open problems on selection principles and splittability (Scheepers–Tsaban tradition). Searches surface related still-open problems (e.g., whether Split(T,T) is additive or preserved under finite powers), but no source was found verifying that the lower bound 𝔲 on add(Split(T,T)) has been improved. Status could not be confirmed; treated as unknown.

status_evidence.title: The combinatorics of splittability
status_evidence.snippet: Studies of properties Split(U,V) and their additivity/preservation, with several open problems concerning T-covers.
status_evidence.claim: Problems on Split(T,T), including additivity, are listed as open.

status_evidence.title: Selection principles in mathematics: A milestone of open problems
status_evidence.snippet: Lists open problems on additivity numbers of selection-principle properties.
status_evidence.claim: Determination of additivity numbers for splittability properties remains an active open problem area.
